body:
## What's Changed
* Implement quoted identifier parsing by @zherczeg in https://github.com/WebAssembly/wabt/pull/2715
* feat(demo): Run js in worker in wat2wasm demo by @spotandjake in https://github.com/WebAssembly/wabt/pull/2568
* Refactor browser demos and Emscripten build output by @kevmoo in https://github.com/WebAssembly/wabt/pull/2721
* Fix wasm2wat demo by @kevmoo in https://github.com/WebAssembly/wabt/pull/2722
* Cleanup how emscripten is invoked by @kevmoo in https://github.com/WebAssembly/wabt/pull/2723
* [demo] Use arrow functions by @kevmoo in https://github.com/WebAssembly/wabt/pull/2725
* Fix Emscripten warnings by removing deprecated writeAsciiToMemory by @kevmoo in https://github.com/WebAssembly/wabt/pull/2724
* [wasm2c] Fix exception testing on macOS by @kevmoo in https://github.com/WebAssembly/wabt/pull/2716
* bug fix for wat2wasm demo to remove call to module.resolveNames by @yuvraj-sahu in https://github.com/WebAssembly/wabt/pull/2726
* [wast-parser] Optimize Consume() by @zherczeg in https://github.com/WebAssembly/wabt/pull/2727
* Move filename out of Location by @zherczeg in https://github.com/WebAssembly/wabt/pull/2728
* Add declaration limit checks to parser by @zherczeg in https://github.com/WebAssembly/wabt/pull/2736
* [lexer] Simplify GetLineOffsets by @zherczeg in https://github.com/WebAssembly/wabt/pull/2735
* Remove debug-parser option and other unused variables by @zherczeg in https://github.com/WebAssembly/wabt/pull/2739
* Use unsigned line info in Locations by @zherczeg in https://github.com/WebAssembly/wabt/pull/2738
* Validator: thread table limits through `OnReturnCallIndirect` by @ggreif in https://github.com/WebAssembly/wabt/pull/2744
* Include error information on error opening output file by @sbc100 in https://github.com/WebAssembly/wabt/pull/2745
* Bump version to 1.0.41 by @sbc100 in https://github.com/WebAssembly/wabt/pull/2746

## New Contributors
* @spotandjake made their first contribution in https://github.com/WebAssembly/wabt/pull/2568
* @kevmoo made their first contribution in https://github.com/WebAssembly/wabt/pull/2721
* @yuvraj-sahu made their first contribution in https://github.com/WebAssembly/wabt/pull/2726
* @ggreif made their first contribution in https://github.com/WebAssembly/wabt/pull/2744

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/WebAssembly/wabt/compare/1.0.40...1.0.41
